subject: MAP + POC Readiness: PulseCardio environment, API keys, allowlist & peering
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pulsecardio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP + POC Readiness: PulseCardio environment, API keys, allowlist & peering

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is our draft mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the technical handoff and the close timeline for the POC. High level items we need to align on this week:

- Org setup: create PulseCardio tenant and invite the engineering service account (instructions in sheet row 3).
- API keys: initial dev keys (ephemeral) for sandbox, and production-scoped keys for the dedicated POC tenant.
- IP allowlist: list of CIDR blocks and a smoke-test window.
- VPC peering: routing prep, shared routes, and target security group rules.
- Acceptance criteria: perf baseline (95th percentile < 250ms for 512-token requests) + sample prompts.

I attached RWI_PulseCardio_MAP_v1.3.xlsx with owners and proposed dates. Quick asks from our side to keep to the week-of-Dec 27 close cadence:

1) Can you confirm who on infra will provision the peering and provide a contact for the firewall admin?
2) Can you add the CIDRs to your allowlist for the dev smoke test on Dec 28 (09:00–12:00 PT)?
3) Who should we send the ephemeral API key rotation schedule to?

If helpful we can run a 30-min technical run-through Wednesday — same agenda as the MAP (org + keys + peering + acceptance).

Regards,

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RWI_PulseCardio_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), vpc-peering-diagram.png (image)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pulsecardio.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@pulsecardio.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 08:37:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP + POC Readiness: PulseCardio environment, API keys, allowlist & peering

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick answers:

- Infra lead for peering is Priya Shah (copied). She will own the VPC request and coordinate with our network team.
- Firewall admin: Victor Lin (victor.lin@pulsecardio.com). I’ll ask him to stand by for the Dec 28 smoke test.
- Ephemeral key rotation: send schedule to security@pulsecardio.com and cc me; we’ll share internal rotation rules.

A couple of items for clarification:
- Can you confirm the exact CIDR block list you’ll originate from (we need source IPs, not just region)?
- For the org tenant, do we get a service account per environment or a single shared service account with scoped keys?

We’re open for the Wednesday run-through; propose 11:00 PT.

— Alex
Director, Cloud Ops — PulseCardio
alex.rivera@pulsecardio.com

Subject: Re: MAP + POC Readiness: PulseCardio environment, API keys, allowlist & peering

Alex —

Thanks for the quick responses. Short answers first: CIDRs we will originate from for the pilot (dev -> staging -> prod): 52.11.34.0/24, 34.210.5.0/24, 18.204.32.0/24. I’ve added them to the third tab in the attached spreadsheet and flagged row owners.

Service account guidance: we recommend one customer-managed tenant with two service accounts:
- rwi-pulse-dev (ephemeral keys, rotate daily during onboarding)
- rwi-pulse-poc (longer-lived key for dedicated POC; rotated weekly)

I’ve also attached a simple acceptance checklist (pulse-acceptance-criteria.md) and a VPC peering diagram. Key proposed milestones from the MAP (excerpt):

- Dec 28: Dev smoke test — allowlist, ephemeral key exchange, simple ping & API workflow (owner: PulseCardio infra)
- Jan 3: Staging load test with quantized model -> perf baseline capture (owner: Redwood SRE)
- Jan 5: Final acceptance review & sign-off (owner: Alex)

Action items for your infra team:
- Priya: initiate peering request w/ VPC IDs + CIDRs today (21 Dec).
- Victor: confirm firewall rule creation window for Dec 28 smoke test (09:00–12:00 PT).

We’ll prepare the ephemeral keys and a short runbook for rotation during the run-through. Meeting confirmed for Wed 11:00 PT unless you want a different time.

Thanks —

Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pulse-acceptance-criteria.md, vpc-peering-diagram.png (see map sheet tab 4)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pulsecardio.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Dec 2027 14:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP + POC Readiness: PulseCardio environment, API keys, allowlist & peering

Alex / Priya —

A few technical clarifications from infra/SRE:

- For peering, we need the full VPC IDs and the exact route table IDs on your side. Please include those in the peering request so we don’t have to do follow-ups.
- Our peering requires that you accept the peering connection within 72 hours once requested. If you anticipate delays over the holidays, we’ll schedule the request for Jan 2 to avoid expiration.
- Ephemeral key flow: we’ll push an initial key via the secure upload link (Doc path in MAP). The dev keys will be delivered as one-time secrets; please confirm someone can rotate them immediately after the smoke test.

Jonas: can you add a quick firewall test script to the MAP that Victor can run as part of the Dec 28 window? I put a placeholder in sheet row 12.

Alex: HubSpot link for the deal is here — please attach your SOW when ready: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4839207/DEAL-324

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Soojin / Ben —

Quick status update from our side:
- Priya created the peering request (VPC ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e); Victor confirmed the firewall window for Jan 5, 08:00–11:00 PT (we bumped due to internal testing).
- We tested the firewall script (Jonas’s placeholder) during the window — all three CIDRs passed connectivity checks.
- We confirmed receipt of the ephemeral dev keys and rotated them after the smoke test.

Next steps:
- Redwood to run the staging load test Jan 10 (please confirm the time).
- We’ll prepare sign-off notes and a short acceptance doc; planning a quick call Jan 12 to confirm final sign-off and billing path.

Thanks for the responsiveness — team is comfortable with the MAP timeline.

— Alex
Director, Cloud Ops — PulseCardio
